description: Copy fill and stroke attributes from one item to others, as the Eyedropper tool does: colour, tint, overprint and gradient angle and length of the fill, and colour, tint, weight, type, alignment, overprint and gradient of the stroke; between items or between the texts of text frames

applyTo.description: item: the frames themselves; text: from the source frame's text to the target frames' text. Default item

source.description: Page item id to copy from

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: copy_fill_stroke
title: Copy Fill Stroke
